summary: Frontend audit for LeadPilot AI landing-page and new pages/flows. Executed comprehensive Playwright coverage across landing nav/hero/pricing/footer, new pages (/pricing, /contact, /privacy, /terms, /cookies, 404), auth flows (Login+2FA, Signup, ForgotPassword), cross-page hash navigation, and mobile menu. 100% of critical flows pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Testid naming inconsistency vs review spec: form inputs use bare testids (e.g. contact-name, contact-email, contact-message, contact-submit, login-email, login-password, login-submit, forgot-email, forgot-submit, signup-email, signup-password, signup-submit) rather than the -input/-btn suffixes hinted in the request. All error/success testids match spec exactly. Consider aliasing or documenting for future testing agents.

Pricing.jsx tier CTAs rely on p.name.toLowerCase() for testids — safe today because pricing array names are Starter/Growth/Enterprise, but a name change silently breaks selectors. Consider hard-coded slugs.
Landing hero CTAs and pricing CTAs are wired via navigate() rather than <Link>, so middle-click / cmd-click won't open in new tab. Minor UX nit.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All landing-page audit items verified functional. Correct testids: Contact form inputs = contact-name/contact-email/contact-company/contact-message/contact-submit; Login = login-email/login-password/login-submit; Signup = signup-firstname/signup-lastname/signup-email/signup-password/signup-terms/signup-submit; Forgot = forgot-email/forgot-submit. OTP: only 1 visible input inside twofa-form; use await slots[0].click() then page.keyboard.type('123456', delay=50). Pricing CTA testids use lowercase tier name (pricing-page-cta-enterprise, pricing-cta-starter/growth/enterprise on Landing).
